import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier, logscale_callback
from lightgbm.sklearn import _early_stopping_cv
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Check for missing values and encode labels
print("\nEncoding label column...")
label_enc = LabelEncoder()
y_train_raw = train_df["Cover_Type"].values

# Fit on ALL training data to capture any label variations
train_labels_encoded = label_enc.fit_transform(y_train_raw)

# Check for unique values and potential issues
print(f"Label classes: {label_enc.classes_}")
print(f"Number of classes: {len(label_enc.classes_)}")

# Prepare features for training
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Cover_Type", "Id"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Fill any potential NaN values
X_train = X_train.fillna(X_train.median())
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].fillna(test_df[feature_cols].median()).copy()

print(f"\nFeature columns: {len(feature_cols)}")

# SPLIT INTO TRAIN/VALIDATION WITHOUT STRATIFICATION (due to rare classes)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_labels_encoded,
    test_size=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=None,
)

print(f"Train: {X_train_full.shape[0]:,}, Val: {X_val.shape[0]:,}")

# Initialize LightGBM classifier with improved early stopping
print("\nTraining LightGBM model with early stopping...")
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=-1,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
)

model.fit(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[LGBMClassifier.early_stopping(callback=_early_stopping_cv)],
)

# Get the optimal number of estimators
n_best_iter = model.n_estimator_
print(f"Early stopping after {n_best_iter} iterations")

# Validate on HOLD-OUT set (this model will NEVER see validation data during training)
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"\nHOLD-OUT VALIDATION ACCURACY: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
print("\nPredicting on test set...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Convert predictions back to original label class
final_preds = label_enc.inverse_transform(y_test_pred)

# Create submission file using template from sample_submission
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
submission_df["Cover_Type"] = final_preds.astype(int)

# Save submission to correct location
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Shape of submission: {submission_df.shape}")

print("\n=== SOLUTION COMPLETE ===")
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
